_comment: CI's busy job: tools/busy_base.py --big --measure busy.json --budget tools/busy_budget.json fails when a number is over the budget times --tolerance (2), or a module over 0.1 ms. Set from CI runs on ubuntu-latest, 2026-10-28, which vary by about 1.5x between runners: total 6-9 ms, belt_items 4.5-6.6 ms (before task 24: 23 ms and 21 ms, UPS 40). Times are ms of script per tick; kb_per_s is what the client receives. world raised from 0.05 to 0.1: the same mod code measured 0.047 to 0.174 ms on different CI runners.
